purpose: Separate method generation timing, transport/retry overhead and execution termination after removing wall cutoffs
planner: current local signed-in ChatGPT Pro gpt-6-astra/xhigh

conditions.name: generation-replay
conditions.unit: Exact failed task183 initial request and image replay, local, no SSH or simulator

conditions.name: known-execution
conditions.unit: Exact205-line source reuse in identical initial state; empty memory; not cold generation

order: generation replay then known execution; sequential Pro calls
time_removal: No application wall/request cutoff or GPT socket read timeout. No finite model RuntimeMaxSec in user systemd. Keep count limits and Jev per-attempt network timeout. API compatibility wall_seconds_remaining is fixed1e12, not an enforced deadline.
process_lifecycle: User systemd transient units; no reboot persistence/global config changes. Bridge captures SIGTERM sender PID/UID. Host uses ordinary signal handler to avoid blocking worker termination.
evidence: SSE event types/counts, first headers/event/reasoning/arguments, complete usage, EOF/chunk errors, retry/backoff, host per-call timings, native terminal outcome. Never log hidden reasoning text or execute partial arguments.
limits: Observed pre-output time includes provider queue/inference/network; event/token counts do not identify exact pure GPU compute time. Raw ChatGPT backend reproduction is not Platform Responses API; official event docs are semantic reference only.
admission: Two declared diagnostic units; preserve failures and unknown costs; no hand editing task source or adding replacement tasks
